body: CHIEF BLOCK: cand-2A9ZTSWMSJEPN68DATQBWNS86V / 8a110880ff6dcc53affdb3fff2dd2e730f7ce906. Two exact defects remain. First, AcquisitionViewAuthority.humanAdjudication and fixtureReview promote arbitrary nonempty bytes to human or fixture authority; fromWire rechecks only a caller-supplied evidence checksum and its deterministic self-signature, with no typed admitted evidence witness. The claimed licence is therefore still caller-mintable. Second, ReportInputIdentity uses unframed colon/equal concatenation for composite coordinates. Exact archive run: two valid accounts differing only as KnownPayloadRef(id=a:b,schema=c,checksum=X) versus (id=a,schema=b:c,checksum=X) both yield ReportInputIdentity(0fd864efedb8). Targeted OutputSuite result is 19 existing PASS and the new court alone FAIL, total 19/20. IdRules explicitly permits colon, so this is reachable, not hypothetical. Preserve the good source/build/receipt joins and prior mutations, but add actually admitted evidence authority plus collision-free framing and payload/provider-param collision courts. No review or authorization on 8a110; await a narrow successor.
